mapper.select: SELECT id,service_id,fulfillment_type,appointment_start_at,appointment_end_at,store_id,user_id,merchant_id,reservation_id,version,order_stage,payment_status, verification_status,confirm_mode,confirm_deadline,paid_at,confirmed_at,canceled_at,cancel_reason, refund_order_id,current_refund_application_id,current_aftersale_id,reschedule_count,pay_amount,refunded_amount FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
